item.title: SpaceX (SPCX) Faces 319M Share Unlock After Reclaiming $135 IPO Price
item.summary: After absorbing a far larger 911-million-share unlock in early August without collapsing, and reclaiming its $135 IPO price for the first time in weeks, SpaceX now faces its next supply test as roughly 319 million more shares become free to trade on August 20.
